run_vllm_serve: run the vllm serve subcommand to launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for LLM completions
run_vllm_chat: run the vllm openai chat subcommand to start an interactive chat session with a running vLLM API server
run_vllm_complete: run the vllm openai complete subcommand to generate text completions from a prompt via the API server
run_vllm_bench: run the vllm bench subcommand to benchmark vLLM with latency, throughput, startup, or serve benchmarks
run_vllm_collect_env: run the vllm collect-env subcommand to collect and display environment information for debugging
